text:
sam: quick call out — we need a decision: when someone saves a per-route view that filters by model, do we persist the resolved routing (region/tier) or always resolve live? reproducibility vs brittle pinning. cc @li @owen @maya

li: my vote: persist a small snapshot at save-time + also support live resolution. default to snapshot for reproducibility. show a clear "snapshot vs live" badge so users know what they're seeing.

owen: agree on snapshot default. implementation note: snapshot should be compact (region/tier|cost_est|latency_est) so DB rows don't bloat. resolve_policy enum: hard|soft|prefer_snapshot.

maya: telemetry requirement: on apply we must emit both snapshot_routing and resolved_routing and effective_sample_rate. otherwise QA can't link regressions to saved views. also emit preview events when users open the saved view.

sam: UX: preview pane shows two columns: Snapshot (what you saved) vs Live (what would run now) with cost/latency deltas. default to showing snapshot but offer a toggle to apply live. add inline copy: "Saved snapshot: eu-west-1 / dedicated-medium. Currently resolves to us-west-2 / burst."

owen: resolver caveat: snapshots may reference pools that get decommissioned. fallback order: try snapshot -> route-default -> cheapest-compatible. UI should show reason if we fall back.

li: API sketch for saved object (string fields to avoid schema churn): v="2", route_id="r_900", model_filter="open-13b@rev-2026-01", snapshot="eu-west-1/dedicated-med|tokens=1200|lat_ms=140", resolution_policy="soft", sampling="0.05". saved objects remain small.

maya: telemetry events to add: saved_view_saved (include snapshot blob if present), saved_view_previewed (live_vs_snapshot boolean), saved_view_applied (resolved_routing_id, snapshot_present, sample_rate, user_id). I'll add schemas to the analytics repo.

infra-bot: queued migration job saved-view-backfill @2912345688 (job/7744).

sam: rollout plan: gate live-resolve preview behind flag, A/B 10% first to measure latency impact and resolver error surface. owners: owen -> API & resolver; maya -> telemetry; li -> UI copy & badges; sam -> rollout + migration. I'll capture in INF-4201 and close here.
